models_evaluated: Machine learning-derived response prediction rule (CRP > 12.3 mg/l and seropositivity)

links.outcome: Real-world odds of LDA and MCID for rule-positive vs rule-negative sarilumab patients
links.effect: Rule-positive patients had higher odds of LDA (OR 1.5 [0.7, 3.2]) and MCID (1.1 [0.5, 2.4]), with wide confidence intervals including 1. Sensitivity analysis (CRP > 5 mg/l) showed better response in rule-positive patients.
links.quote: Among the predictive rule cohort (N = 205), rule-positive (vs. rule-negative) patients were more likely to reach LDA (odds ratio: 1.5 [0.7, 3.2]) and MCID (1.1 [0.5, 2.4]).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world applicability and external validation of an ML-derived clinical decision rule in a real-world registry cohort.
